title: You're Not Powerless
devotional: Temptation can make you feel as though you have no choice. A thought appears, a desire grows, and suddenly the wrong decision feels inevitable. But temptation is not the same thing as obedience. You may feel pressure without having to surrender to it. Today, remember that you can stop, step away, and turn toward God. Your first victory may simply be recognizing what is happening before you act.
mind_check: What situation, thought, or emotion usually makes you feel like giving in?
body_move: Change your physical position when temptation begins. Stand up, leave the room, put the phone down, or move toward a healthier environment.
spirit_move: Pause and turn your attention toward God. Read 1 Corinthians 10:13 and ask Him for wisdom and strength to choose the way out.
way_out: When __________ happens, I will __________ instead of giving in.
prayer: Father, help me recognize temptation before I surrender to it. Give me wisdom to see the way out and courage to take it. Help me turn toward You instead of trusting my impulses. Strengthen my mind, discipline my body, and help me walk in obedience today. Amen.
action: Write down one situation that commonly pulls you toward temptation. Then write one specific action you will take the next time it happens.
